title: v0.8.6 - Dashboard Collaborative Chat
description: This release enhances dashboard collaboration with @mentions, AI-powered queries, in-app notifications, table elements, image sharing, and smart caching.

items.title: @Mention System
items.description: Mention users and Pegasus AI directly in dashboard chat with an intuitive autocomplete popup.
details: Inline Popup: Type '@' to trigger suggestions for Pegasus AI and dashboard collaborators.
Keyboard Navigation: Use arrow keys to navigate and Enter to select mentions.
Highlighted Mentions: @mentions are styled distinctly in chat messages.

items.title: @Pegasus AI Queries
items.description: Ask Pegasus questions about your dashboard data directly from the chat.
details: Context-Aware: AI queries automatically include dashboard context like table elements.
Real-time Responses: See 'Pegasus is thinking...' indicator while AI processes.
AI Message Styling: Responses display with a distinct gradient avatar and styling.

items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: Stay informed when you're mentioned in dashboard chats.
details: Unread Badge: Shows count of unread notifications.
Quick Navigation: Click a notification to jump directly to the dashboard.
Notification Management: Mark as read or clear all notifications.

items.title: Table Dashboard Element
items.description: Display live database tables directly in your dashboard.
details: Inline Data View: Reuses DataViewerModal patterns without the modal wrapper.
Search & Sort: Filter and sort columns directly in the element.
Pagination: Navigate large datasets with built-in pagination.

items.title: Image Uploads in Chat
items.description: Share images directly in dashboard chat conversations.
details: Drag & Drop or Click: Upload images via the paperclip button.
Preview Before Send: See thumbnails of pending images before sending.
Base64 Storage: Images stored directly in messages for simplicity.

items.title: Dashboard Caching (SWR)
items.description: Implemented stale-while-revalidate caching for faster dashboard loading.
details: Instant Load: Cached dashboards display immediately while fresh data loads.
Background Refresh: Revalidation happens automatically in the background.
15-min TTL: Default cache expiration with localStorage persistence.

items.title: Enhanced Socket Events
items.description: New socket events power the real-time collaborative features.
details: pegasus_query: Handles AI queries with dashboard context.
user_mentioned: Notifies users when they're @mentioned.
pegasus_thinking: Broadcasts AI processing state to room.
